name: Foul Magics
summary: In Hammerfall, Tor'gan fears a warlock in Stromgarde is calling demons with an arcane relic. Your first work for him has led to a hunt for the warlock and the relic.

sections.title: A Warlock in Stromgarde
sections.body: Tor'gan is certain a warlock within Stromgarde's walls uses an arcane relic to call up terrible demons in great numbers. The burning in his blood grows by the day. So he sends you to find and kill the warlock, then bring back the magical object on the warlock's body. He means to destroy it before its power can taint the land. The warlock is Marez Cowl, and the object is a Befouled Bloodstone Orb.

sections.title: What the Orb Recalls
sections.body: With the orb destroyed, Tor'gan expects his restless nights to give way to peaceful sleep. The orb recalls the dreadful hold demons once had over the orcs. That hold endured until Hellscream freed them from their curse.

faq.q: Who sends you to hunt the warlock?
faq.answer: Tor'gan in Hammerfall sends you into Stromgarde to find the warlock and bring him the magical object on the warlock's body.
Marez Cowl hides within Stromgarde's walls, west of and outside the Keep, behind a building. You can hear her channeling a spell.

faq.q: What relic are you sent to retrieve?
faq.answer: You are sent to retrieve Marez Cowl's Befouled Bloodstone Orb. Tor'gan wants it brought to him for destruction.

faq.q: Why does Tor'gan want the warlock stopped?
faq.answer: The warlock has summoned terrible demons in large numbers using an arcane relic. Tor'gan wants you to remove the relic's power and destroy the orb before it can taint the land.
